name: 99-fad-felen
description: Fad Felen: a gaunt hairless grey beast with a pale skull face inside a big shaggy golden-yellow mane, long thin tail, drooling. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Crouched in place on all fours facing right, menacing idle: it breathes slowly, the shoulders rising and falling, the mane stirring, the head lowering slightly as drool drips, then lifting again. Its face is a bone-white skull with big dark round eye sockets and bared teeth in every frame; the skull never changes, closes its eyes or becomes a face. Only the body, mane, head position and drool move. Feet stay planted. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No walking or effects.

standing.action: Standing hunched on its hind legs in place facing right, menacing idle: it sways and breathes slowly, arms hanging, the mane stirring, the head lowering as drool drips, then lifting. Its face is a bone-white skull with big dark round eye sockets and bared teeth in every frame; the skull never changes, closes its eyes or becomes a face. Only the body, mane, head position and drool move. Feet stay planted. Same size, black one-pixel outlines, flat fills. No walking or effects.
